# Evidence-Gated Execution Plan

Boruch Hashem. Blessed is He.

The Awtsmoos joins Chesed and Gevurah: reveal as much public Torah as search can receive, while bounding every doorway by canonical identity, status, and public visibility.

## Phase A — Current reality

- Inspect recent Git history affecting Geelooy route/SEO files.
- Read current route modules and dynamic response contracts.
- Probe current production and local HTML without JavaScript.
- Identify the current server startup/environment contract.

## Phase B — Resolve implementation delta

- Fix only evidenced defects in current HEAD.
- Keep Road resolution server-side and public-API-backed.
- Normalize direct/root post behavior onto the valid series-scoped API.
- Add or repair robots and sitemap routes if still absent.
- Ensure Heichel/series fallback links are public and crawlable.
- Keep page canonical metadata aligned with the same resolved entity data.

## Phase C — Verification

- Run syntax/import checks for all touched JavaScript.
- Run focused resolver tests using deterministic mock fixtures.
- Start a separate isolated server process from current checkout.
- Curl Road, named post, Heichel, robots, and sitemap endpoints.
- Assert initial HTML contains Torah text and metadata without JS execution.
- Use browser control against the fresh server to verify client hydration/navigation.
- Re-read all touched files and inspect the final diff.

## Phase D — Completion

- Update REMAINING_WORK with evidence-backed completion states.
- Record plan-versus-actual delta and any intentionally deferred work.
- Do not call complete while any safe verification or crawl-discovery obligation remains.
